title: NSW - Upgrade the Network
current_summary:
Maintenance on some Fixed Wireless services is under way, with a window of 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEDT on 19 October 2026. Two interruptions of up to 10 minutes each are scheduled around 12:30 AM and 1:30 AM AEDT.

This deployment is part of a program to improve Fixed Wireless performance. It supports the shift from Long Term Evolution (LTE) to 5G to enable faster speed tiers as demand grows and boosts network resilience with better failover paths, helping reduce outages and avoid capacity issues.

nbn® is completing works to improve the nbn network capacity in your area. This will cause your nbn service to lose connection.
Using mobile data where available can help you stay connected while your service is offline. Minimise disruption to your routine by downloading required files and switching to offline work modes.

updates.content:
We will be performing planned works with our network partner that will affect some Fixed Wireless services in NSW. The maintenance window is from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEDT on 19 October 2026. During this time, services may drop briefly. Two short interruptions of up to 10 minutes are expected around 12:30 AM and 1:30 AM AEDT.

No action is required. If you need to stay online during the window, you may wish to use mobile data where available. Services should return automatically once the work is complete. We will monitor progress and update this notice if the schedule changes.
The planned maintenance has now started. Affected services may drop briefly during the window, which is still scheduled to finish at 6:00 AM AEDT on 19 October 2026.
